svg.title: Ultrasonic distance instrument: system block diagram
svg.desc: Raspberry Pi Pico WH on a DFRobot Pico Gravity board reads two HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensors (left and right, pinged alternately, each Echo through its own 1 kilohm / 2 kilohm divider) and a push button. The nearer valid distance sets the colour and blink rate of an RGB LED and a relay that clicks once per blink. A 1.3 inch SH1106 OLED on I2C0 shows both distances in metres. Like a security camera, the device logs distance events (zone changes, visits, samples), stamped to the second, to ThingSpeak over the on-board Wi-Fi.
